intro: Planning ahead: budgets against what you spend, and loans you have taken or given.
start: Set a budget for the year, then compare it with the books.

articles.title: Set a budget and hold spending to it
articles.summary: Plan a year's amount per account, get it approved, and make it active so requisitions, orders and bills are checked against it.

steps.rest: give it a name and choose the fiscal year.
and the amount for the year. It is spread over the months.
and choose how it controls: only warn or block when spending goes over, at which stages, and the thresholds to tell its owner at.
then Activate once approved. Spending is now held against it.

articles.after: Each line shows what is spent, committed and still available, against the budget.
tips: To move money between lines or change one, press Revise or transfer. It is approved like the budget.

articles.title: Record a loan and its repayments
articles.summary: Add money you borrowed with its rate and term. The instalments are worked out and join the cash forecast.

steps.lead: Give the lender, the amount borrowed, the interest a year and the term,
steps.rest: and the day it was lent.

steps.lead: Choose how often instalments fall and how it is repaid:
steps.rest: equal payments, equal principal, or interest only, with any grace period.
Its instalments are worked out, always repaying the amount borrowed exactly.
when you pay one, with the amount and the day.
